notes.title: Underminer 240119 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Miners!
Today, I'd like to introduce you to a new patch.

Added and Modified Features
- Added a feature where a guidance UI appears when entering a new stratum.
- Changed to play different ambient sounds for each stratum.

Performance Improvements
- Relieves some of the frame drop issues in the later game.

UI/UX Improvements
- Clicking [New Game] with no save file will now starts the tutorial.
- ‘Tutorial - Upgrade’ information added.
- Improved visibility of keyboard control icons.

See you in the underground!
Thank you.
